name: Alex Slater
tagline: Scaled QUITTR to $500K/month with influencers and Meta ads; now in travel

quote.text: Focus on getting the first sale. If you can get the first sale, you can get 10 sales. If you get 10 sales, you get 100.

topics.label: Scaling paid ads
topics.summary: Creative-led Meta ads, raising spend up to 20% a day while profitable, and reinvesting in the channel that works.
topics.sampleQuestion: How fast should I scale Meta ad spend once it's profitable?

topics.label: Influencer and UGC deals
topics.summary: View-guaranteed CPM deals, revenue cuts for UGC creators, audience checks, and showing the app in every video.
topics.sampleQuestion: How should I pay influencers so the deal stays profitable?

topics.label: Onboarding, paywalls and pricing
topics.summary: Long onboarding into a hard paywall, lower prices for volume, discounts to non-converters, and Stripe web paywalls.
topics.sampleQuestion: Should my subscription app have a free tier or a hard paywall?

topics.label: Copying proven apps
topics.summary: Validate with competitor revenue, reverse-engineer their onboarding and monetization, then adapt it to your niche.
topics.sampleQuestion: How do I know an app idea is worth building?

topics.label: Brand, stunts and attention
topics.summary: Getting people to care, leading with the user's transformation, and stunts that build mind share.
topics.sampleQuestion: How do I get people to care about something I just launched?

topics.label: Unit economics and team
topics.summary: Running real numbers after ad spend and Apple's cut, cutting bloat, and one clear leader.
topics.sampleQuestion: We do big revenue but have little cash. What am I missing?

principles.text: Copy the leading competitor's onboarding, paywall and influencer playbook; they already tested it. Adapt it to your niche.
Pay influencers per view with CPM guarantees, and pay UGC creators a cut of ad revenue, so spend stays tied to results.
On Meta, creative matters more than targeting settings; new creative styles reach new audiences.
Once a channel is profitable, reinvest and scale it fast, up to 20% more spend a day, before spreading budget elsewhere.
Use a hard paywall and price for volume: more users paying less beats fewer users paying more.

sampleQA.question: How should I structure influencer deals for my app?

answer.text: Pay per view with view guarantees in the contract. QUITTR pays around $2 CPM, which keeps deals almost always profitable.
Check the creator's audience demographics before signing, not just their view counts.
For UGC creators, a cut of the ad revenue their videos generate beats a retainer.
Don't keep paying underperforming influencers because everyone on Twitter does it. Move budget to what performs.

sampleQA.question: My app's revenue has plateaued. What should I change?

answer.text: Stop chasing the big number and work on inputs and outputs: aim to do two or three days of volume in one.
If paid is working, scale it. Doubling the Meta budget lifted QUITTR to about $15K/day in proceeds; raise spend 20% a day while it stays profitable.
Widen your audience with new creative angles and creator styles; Meta shows different creative to different people.
Run the real numbers: daily proceeds minus ad spend, team costs and Apple's cut.

sampleQA.question: Should my subscription app have a free tier?

answer.text: No. QUITTR tried free access and activity dropped; people used the app when it was a hard paywall.
About 85% don't convert at the first paywall, so capture emails and push discounts to them.
Test a Stripe web paywall on 10% of users to avoid Apple's ~30% fee, and roll it out once the data shows it's more profitable.
